response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall_avg_value AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT ta.avg_pulse FROM telescope_averages ta WHERE ta.avg_pulse > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_value)), second_avg_value AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_average FROM above_overall), final_telescopes AS (SELECT ao.avg_pulse FROM above_overall ao WHERE ao.avg_pulse > (SELECT second_average FROM second_avg_value)) SELECT AVG(ft.avg_pulse) as mean_avg_pulse, AVG(ft.avg_pulse - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_value)) as avg_above_overall, AVG(ft.avg_pulse - (SELECT second_average FROM second_avg_value)) as avg_above_second FROM final_telescopes ft
